prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop hospitality homepage concept, 1440px-wide landscape canvas, edge to edge with no browser or device frame.
Input images: Image 1 is the exact resort logo and identity reference; Image 2 is the real aerial photograph of the resort buildings; Image 3 is the real resort court and garden photograph; Image 4 is a real apartment bedroom. Keep these as recognizable factual property photographs inside the design; do not redesign the architecture.
Primary request: Direction B — Minimal Architectural Luxury for ‘The 12 by Naji Resort’. Design a shippable homepage whose structure feels like an architectural survey: measured, calm, and exact. Avoid a conventional left-copy/right-image split. Build the first viewport on a disciplined twelve-column grid with the aerial resort image as one large horizontal architectural plate interrupted by precise ivory margins and hairline coordinate rules. Let ‘Redefining Resort Living.’ sit at monumental scale across the image boundary, while ‘UTAKO · ABUJA’ and ‘APARTMENT RESORT’ behave like concise drawing annotations.
Frame: compact wordmark at top left; Rooms, Gallery, Tours, Events, Contact in one clean line; restrained gold ‘Book Now’ action. Integrate a working booking band as part of the grid at the foot of the viewport with ‘Check in’, ‘Check out’, ‘Apartment’, and ‘View apartments’. Reveal the start of ‘Two apartment blocks’ below, using one court image and one bedroom image as unequal architectural plates, not cards.
Visual law: chalk #F2F1ED, carbon #121212, concrete #A8A39A, white #FFFFFF, restrained brand brass #B78B3E. Use a precise contemporary grotesk with a small technical mono voice. Square corners, no rounded cards, no shadows, no gradients, no decorative blueprint clichés.
Constraints: readable real UI, strong whitespace, one dominant photographic plate, factual property imagery only, no prices, ratings, awards, fake availability, people, stock assets, or extra logos.
editPrompt: Change only the small location annotation in the upper-right area that currently shows latitude and longitude coordinates. Remove the two numeric coordinate lines completely and replace them with two restrained uppercase lines: ‘HOME TRUST ESTATE’ and ‘UTAKO, ABUJA’. Preserve every other design decision.
